author: VH
releaseNotes: TS-3.0.0 (TecnoSimples) — Botões com pushed/held corretos (um toque gera um evento, sem atraso de 2 s, duplo clique funciona), reconexão que não morre, analógicas com escala e unidade configuráveis e muito menos eventos; regras que contavam com held e pushed no mesmo toque precisam de ajuste. / Buttons with correct pushed/held (one press gives one event, no 2 s delay, double press works), reconnection that never dies, analog inputs with configurable scale and unit and far fewer events; rules that relied on held and pushed in the same press need adjusting.
